repoguide.performanceMode.description: Fast: single-pass retrieval, quick answers. Deep: multi-pass reasoning with gap detection, better for complex flow and architecture questions.
enumDescriptions: Deep: multi-pass reasoning with gap detection, better for complex flow and architecture questions.

repoguide.qaGenerationModel.description: Ollama model used for background Q&A cache generation

repoguide.tokenBudget.description: Max tokens of code context per query

repoguide.retrieval.reranker.description: Cross-encoder reranking of retrieved code before it is packed into the model's context (on by default, using bge). Retrieval scores never see the question, so a genuinely relevant snippet can be cut by the context budget while generic high-scoring matches survive -- reranking rescores the shortlist against the actual question. Measured against a no-reranker baseline over 38 real questions: misattributed citations roughly halved (11 -> 6) with no loss of answer substance, for ~11% added latency (28.2s -> 31.4s median) and no VRAM. 'minilm' = ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 is a lighter fallback for slower hardware, but measured WORSE than baseline on answer substance. Both run on CPU.

repoguide.determinism.resetModelBeforeSy.description: Reproducibility over speed (on by default). Ollama's answer to a question depends on the request that preceded it, so with this off the same question can answer differently depending on what you asked earlier in the session -- occasionally enough to change whether an answer is delivered or withheld. Dropping Ollama's resident model before each answer makes results depend only on the question. Measured cost end-to-end: 21.1s -> 25.0s median (+18%). Turn off only if you want the lowest possible latency and can accept that a repeated question may answer differently.

repoguide.idleUnloadTimeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before suggesting Ollama model unload to free VRAM (0 = never)

repoguide.decomposition.enabled.description: Break genuinely multi-part questions (architecture walkthroughs, multi-step flows) into ordered sub-questions, answer and verify each separately, and merge the verified parts into one answer. Costs roughly 2.5-3x the latency of a single-shot answer when it fires; simple questions always stay single-shot regardless of this setting.

repoguide.memory.bridge.enabled.description: Inject relevant entries from RepoGuide's memory store into the evidence packet alongside retrieved code. Off by default: memory entries are lower-confidence than AST-derived facts and consume context budget that would otherwise hold real code.

repoguide.enableChatNoteDistillation.description: Distil chat answers into durable notes as you work. Off by default; adds background model calls after answers.

repoguide.enableDailyBriefOnStartup.description: Generate a repository brief when the extension starts. Off by default; adds startup work before the workspace is usable.

repoguide.debugLogging.description: Enable debug-level logging in the RepoGuide output channel and log files

repoguide.captureTerminalErrors.description: Capture failed VS Code shell-integration commands for RepoGuide terminal investigations. Requires shell integration support.

repoguide.enableCoverageIngestion.description: Runs the test suite with coverage instrumentation in the background to feed RepositoryBrain's coverage-risk analysis. Adds a background test run; leave off unless you want this.

repoguide.maxIndexedFiles.description: Maximum number of files to index. If the repository has more walkable files than this, indexing prioritizes entry points, then most-recently-modified files, then shallowest directory depth, and the gap is surfaced in query results instead of failing silently.

repoguide.indexingConcurrency.description: Number of files processed concurrently during indexing (embedding, extraction, chunking). 0 auto-derives from available CPUs (capped at 4, matching Ollama's default parallel-request limit).
